component-o.description-s: 4.7 µH ±20% shielded power inductor, SRP5030T series, 5.7 x 5.2 x 2.8 mm, DCR 53 mΩ max, Irms 4.6 A, Isat 6.0 A; buyable replacement for the obsolete Coilcraft XAL1010-472MEB as the LTC3124 two-phase boost coil (the coil peak is bounded by the LTC3124's 4.5 A max per-phase switch current limit, so a 24 A part is not needed)

specs-o.current_note_s: Bourns SRP table: Isat = inductance drops 20 % (typ); Irms = 40 °C rise
